flagKey.description: The key of the flag to change, e.g. "checkout-new-button".

enabled.description: Turn the flag on (true) or off (false).

regions.description: The regions that are eligible. Replaces the current list, so include every region you want.

rolloutPercent.description: Share of the eligible users who get the feature, 0–100.

set.description: The fields to change. Leave a field out to keep its current value.

reason.description: Why the change is needed, in the user's words. Saved to the flag's history.
